title: ClusterMLIP fragment AFM guess specification
description: Input to `cluster-mlip prepare-spins --fragment-spec`. Editors that support $schema will validate example files like spin_fragments.example.json against this while you edit them. cluster_mlip.spin.validate_fragment_specification_shape() enforces the same shape at runtime, plus the semantic checks (atom coverage, charge/spin consistency) documented in the README.

record_id.description: record_id of a trusted high-spin seed, e.g. from spin-extract's seeds.extxyz

name.description: Short label used to build the job_id and .gjf filename

atoms.description: 1-based atom indices; every atom in the record must be covered exactly once across all fragments

multiplicity.description: Fragment multiplicity; orientation carries the sign, this is always positive
